prompt: A football team gains $5$ yards, loses $8$ yards, then gains $3$ yards. What is the **net yardage**?
hint: Net yardage combines every play into one number. Decide what sign a gain should have and what sign a loss should have.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try only the first two plays: gaining $5$ and then losing $8$ leaves the team $3$ yards behind. Now include the last play.
Net yardage combines every play into one number. Decide what sign a gain should have and what sign a loss should have.
Write the gains as positive and the loss as negative: $5 - 8 + 3$. Work from left to right, or add the two gains first.
$5 - 8 = -3$ and $-3 + 3 = 0$, so the net yardage is $0$ yards.

explanation: Write each play as an integer: gains are positive and the loss is negative, giving $5 - 8 + 3$.
Combine the first two plays: $5 - 8 = -3$, so the team is $3$ yards behind where it started.
Add the last gain: $-3 + 3 = 0$, because a number plus its opposite is zero.
The net yardage is $0$, so the team ends where it started.
